## Mandatory Self-Review Checklist
*The author must leave 3 inline comments on the PR files (Architectural, Technical, Security) before merging.*

- [ ] **Architectural:** Verified Clean Architecture boundaries (Domain purity, no infrastructure leaks).
- [ ] **Technical:** Verified edge cases, CQRS patterns, and error handling.
- [ ] **Security:** Verified OWASP mitigations (AuthZ, Budget Enforcement, Prompt Injection safety).
- [ ] **Tests:** Added/updated unit or integration tests for new business logic.
- [ ] **Docs:** Updated relevant documentation (SDD, BRD, or README) if behavior changed.
